posts.cooked: U can not open bpt from power shell. U have to connect to VM. Follow the video to connect to VM properly. Remove old .ssh folder files and regenerate your private and public keys using ssh-keygen. And submit the public key in password less portal. And then try to connect to VM

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
The solution is not correct and misleading.

  • you can ssh from powershell like WSL as well
  • the issue you are facing is not due to public or private key
  • your system has stored an old identification of the server, as VM has changed server so it is not allowing to connect. To fix you simply need to run ssh-keygen -R se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in
  • This will delete the row for se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in in the ~/.ssh/known_hosts file.
  • A harsher and unnecessary way to solve this is to delete the entire ~/.ssh/known_hosts file.
  • Asking students to delete the entire ~/.ssh directory when not required and asking them to regenerate public private key pair is unnecessary and confuses the student.
